# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 2 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Joseph Arrives at Pentephres' House

---

**1** When Pentephres heard that Joseph was coming to him, he said to his daughter Aseneth: "Joseph, the Mighty One of God, is coming to us today. Go to your upper chamber and remain there; do not show yourself to him.

**2** Joseph is a man devoted to God, self-controlled, and he does not tolerate any foreign woman coming near him — he will not allow a woman to speak with him. But we will receive him and he will dine with us, and you may observe him from above through the latticed window. You may take pleasure in seeing him."

**3** When Aseneth heard her father's words she was overjoyed and said: "If that is so, let him come in, and I will watch him through the latticed window."

**4** Aseneth hurried and adorned herself with her finest garments and gold ornaments. She arranged her hair and placed a golden diadem on her head and golden bracelets on her wrists.

**5** She dressed in robes embroidered with gold and fine linen, and put golden sandals on her feet, adorning herself with all the ornaments befitting a virgin.

**6** She went up to the upper chamber and stood at the east window so that she could see Joseph approaching her father's house.

**7** And behold, a chariot drawn by white horses arrived, and Joseph was riding in it. The chariot was decorated with gold, and the horses were white as snow.

**8** Joseph wore a white tunic with a white cloak wrapped around him, and on his head was a golden crown set with twelve chosen stones, above which rose twelve golden rays.

**9** In his right hand Joseph held a royal scepter of olive wood; in his left he held an olive branch laden with abundant fruit glistening with oil.

**10** Joseph arrived at Pentephres' house, and Pentephres with his wife and all his household came out to meet him and bowed to the ground before him.

**11** Joseph descended from the chariot and extended his right hand to Pentephres.

**12** When Aseneth saw Joseph, she was shaken to her core. Her soul melted, her knees buckled, and her whole body trembled with fear. She said within herself: "What shall I do now, wretched as I am? Did I not say that Joseph would come — the son of a shepherd from the land of Canaan? And now behold, the sun from heaven has come to us on his chariot and entered our house."

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
